test_objective: Check that one can list all the cached @context entries

test_cases.name: 052_07_01 List @contexts with details set to true and kind set to cached and with previously several add @contexts
test_cases.doc: Check that one can find a previously cached context
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        List @contexts with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        List @contexts with Response reason set to 'OK'     and
        List @contexts with Check Context Response Body Containing a list of identifiers and
            Query Parameter: kind set to 'Cached'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/jsonldContexts?${params_as_string}'
        method set to 'GET'
        List @contexts: and
    Query Parameter: details set to 'true' and
    Query Parameter: kind set to 'Cached'
}
